_doc: Gym sites. kind decides the build; lon/lat is the anchor (OSM where available). Leaders and interiors come later.

gyms.name: Tanganyika Wildlife Park
gyms.note: park stays outdoors; the entrance building is a FireRed Gym

gyms.name: Kansas Aviation Museum
gyms.note: its own building: the 1935 terminal with its control tower, aircraft on the ramp

gyms.name: Hartman Arena
gyms.note: its own building; OSM now names it Heartland Credit Union Arena

gyms.name: Rock River Rapids
gyms.note: water park outdoors; the entrance building is a FireRed Gym

gyms.name: Haysville Historic Park
gyms.note: 200 S Main St, beside the Vickers Petroleum station

gyms.name: Maize farm country
gyms.note: northwest of Maize in the farmland; exact farm can be moved

gyms.name: Cheney State Park Safari Zone
gyms.note: booth at the west county line on W 21st St N; the state park is its own map (Safari Zone with the Gym built in)
